title: Fractions Fun: Sharing Pizza!
tagline: Learn all about fractions by sharing yummy treats with our fox friend!
style_guide: Clean modern flat illustration, bold primary colors (red, blue, yellow on cream background), friendly mascot, minimal background, generous whitespace, soft drop shadows.
recurring_character_description: a smiling red fox with a striped blue scarf, large expressive eyes

scenes.visual_prompt: Top-down view, bright studio lighting, cheerful inviting mood, clean modern flat illustration, bold primary colors (red, blue, yellow on cream background), a smiling red fox with a striped blue scarf, large expressive eyes, sitting happily next to a perfectly round, uncut pepperoni pizza, soft drop shadow.
scenes.audio_dialogue: Hey there! Ever had a big, yummy pizza all to yourself? It's the best feeling, right?

scenes.visual_prompt: Top-down view, bright studio lighting, cheerful inviting mood, clean modern flat illustration, bold primary colors (red, blue, yellow on cream background), a smiling red fox with a striped blue scarf, large expressive eyes, carefully cutting a round pepperoni pizza exactly down the middle into two equal halves with a pizza cutter, soft drop shadow.
scenes.audio_dialogue: But what if you want to share it with a friend? You'd cut it right down the middle, making two equal pieces!

checkpoint.question: When you cut a pizza into two equal pieces, what do we call each piece?
checkpoint.explanation: That's right! When you split something into two equal parts, each part is called a half.

scenes.visual_prompt: Top-down view, bright studio lighting, cheerful inviting mood, clean modern flat illustration, bold primary colors (red, blue, yellow on cream background), a smiling red fox with a striped blue scarf, large expressive eyes, now cutting each of the two pizza halves into two more equal pieces, resulting in four equal slices arranged like a whole pizza, soft drop shadow.
scenes.audio_dialogue: Now you have two halves! And if you cut each half again, you get even more pieces. Each of these four equal pieces is called a quarter!

scenes.visual_prompt: Top-down view, bright studio lighting, cheerful inviting mood, clean modern flat illustration, bold primary colors (red, blue, yellow on cream background), a smiling red fox with a striped blue scarf, large expressive eyes, pointing to the four equal pizza slices that are now perfectly rejoined to form the original whole pizza, soft drop shadow.
scenes.audio_dialogue: See? Each small piece is just a part of the big, whole pizza. Fractions help us talk about these equal parts!

questions.question: What is a 'whole' pizza before you cut it?
questions.explanation: Before you cut it, a pizza is one whole, complete item!

questions.question: How many equal pieces do you get if you cut a pizza into 'halves'?
questions.explanation: You get two equal pieces when you cut something in half.

questions.question: If you have four equal pieces of pizza, what is each piece called?
questions.explanation: Each of four equal pieces is called a quarter.
